title: Injury Engine
tagline: Let them know when how much it hurts (injury 💔, healing ❤️‍🩹, and torture❤️‍🔥)
description:
Per-body-part injuries for SkyrimNet. Damage from any source (swords, arrows, spells, creatures, falls and torture) wounds a body part, and the wound gets worse from light to medium to severe. While the wounds heal, every character who looks at the victim knows what they look like, and the victim knows how they feel. Hits, healing and killing blows are narrated to the LLM, and an overlay shows each tortured actor's damage.

Torture is built in: whipping (with a padded whip), pinching, slapping, pulling, punching, and fire, frost and shock torture spells. Torture hurts but cannot kill. NPCs can torture someone with the Torture_Target LLM action.

## Features

- **Injuries from all damage**: each hit is classified by what caused it: slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, burning, freezing, shocking, mauling, falling, generic, or one of the torture types. The wound lands on a body part: face, back, left or right arm, left or right leg, plus optional sexual parts. Each part moves through light, medium and severe.
- **Healing**: wounds heal over game time, with healing spells, staffs and potions, and slowly with natural regeneration. When a healing source starts working on someone, a heal session begins: it is narrated, and the wounds are described by how far they have healed.
- **Narration**: real-damage hits, torture, healing and killing blows are narrated to the LLM, or recorded as short-lived events when narration isn't allowed. A narration isn't allowed when it is turned off, when the victim is out of sight, or when someone is already speaking. Continuous torture is combined into one narration every few seconds, covering everyone torturing at the same time. A change of method is narrated at once.
- **Wound prompts**: a character-bio section says what each wounded part looks like. A final-instructions section tells the speaker how their wounds feel, or how the healing feels while a spell, staff or potion is working.
- **Torture damage**: torture types are whipping, pinching, slapping, pulling and punching (fists outside combat), plus fire, frost and shock torture. Fire, frost and shock come from the spells Flames (torture), Frostbite (torture) and Sparks (torture); the normal spells stay real damage. Torture holds health down but never below 10%, so it can't kill. Each type is tracked per body part, but a part counts only its worst type, and healing a part heals every type on it at once.
- **Torture_Target LLM action**: an NPC walks to the target and whips, pinches, slaps, pulls or punches them 1–N times. Whipping needs the padded whip.
- **Stop_Fighting / Stop_Fighting_by_Yielding / Start_Fighting LLM actions**: an NPC in a fight can offer to stop, or yield (surrender: it puts its weapon away at once, and the other side may accept the surrender or keep attacking); SkyrimNet's decision model decides whether the other side accepts (needs a decision provider set up in SkyrimNet, otherwise the offer is refused). Accepted: both stand down and stay calm for a day. Refused: the NPC stands down, the other may fight on. When the offer or surrender is made to you, a Yes / No box asks whether you accept. Any NPC can also start a fight with someone, or switch targets mid-fight.
- **Padded whip** (`Injury_Engine_PaddedWhip`): every real hit with it is a lash. To get one:
 - craft it at the forge with DOM's recipe (leather strips plus one other vanilla item);
 - use "Add gear to player";
 - or type `help "Padded whip"` → `player.additem` in the console.

 A lash leaves the same welt decal as DOM.
- **Torture overlay**: a "Torture Damage" bar per tortured actor. It shows how much the last kind of torture (whip, pinch, fire, ...) has wounded the parts it can reach, each kind in its own color. It is light blue while the actor is being healed and red where real damage has replaced torture. It fades out by itself.
- **Extensible**: other mods can add their own injury types as `injuries/<id>.json`; SkyrimNet_Leashed adds leash dragging. Other mods can also wound or heal a chosen body part through the External API (docs/developers/papyrus.md).

The whip, its welt decal, and its sounds come from **PAH Diary Of Mine**. This mod does not need DOM.

changelog:
## 0.1.0

### Requirements 
- Requires SkyrimNet 0.25.0, SKSE, Address Library, PapyrusUtil SE and PrismaUI.

### Pain and Healing 
- Every hit wounds a body part: swords, arrows, spells, creatures, falls and torture.
- Wounds go from light to medium to severe and heal over time, with regeneration and healing magic.
- Torture, healing, hits and killing blows are narrated, and NPCs see and feel the wounds.
- Other mods can add injury types and wound or heal body parts.

### Torture 
- Torture (whip, pinch, slap, pull, punch, fire, frost, shock) hurts but can't kill.
- Victims tortured far enough collapse until they are healed (setting).
- Craft the padded whip at the forge; "Add gear to player" also gives the three torture spells.
- Torture and lashes don't start fights.
- NPCs can torture someone with the Torture_Target action.
- A torture overlay shows a bar per tortured actor and fades out by itself.
- Optional damageable sexual body parts (setting).

### Real Damage 
- Real damage replaces torture wounds first, so a tortured victim dies only after that.

### Combat start, stop, yield
- NPCs can offer to stop a fight or yield; offers to you show a Yes / No box.
- NPCs can start a fight with Start_Fighting.
